0.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_000
0.description: You're that adventurer everyone's talking about, aren't you? The one working with the Allied forces? If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.

3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_010
5.description: You can call me M'zalikko. If I'm not mistaken you've already met my older sister, Naago.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_013
6.description: Our father, M'rahz Nunh, is leader of the M tribe. He's likely one of the few males you'll ever see among us.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_014
7.description: They stay only to challenge him in a bid to claim his title of nunh. Those who fail remain as tia, or leave and attempt to create tribes of their own.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_015
8.description: Under normal circumstances, there can be only one nunh in our tribe, you see. Although there was a time when our lands were vast, and two nunhs led our people.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_020
9.description: Thanks to you and yours driving the Garleans out of Castellum Velodyna, we can finally start getting things back to the way they were.

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_021
10.description: In the darker days of their occupation, it was M'rahz Nunh who inspired us, who gave us the strength to live.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_022
11.description: We owe him our lives, and we'll gladly give them to defend him and our home.

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR3THEPEERINGSTONES_00395_MZALIKKO_000_023
12.description: I doubt there has ever been a nunh before him so loved by his people.
